doc.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Would he do it again, and non-music jobs
summary: Gordon would choose a musician's life again; he sometimes held non-musical jobs.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Would you do it all over again?
Yes I think I would, yeah.
I’m glad to hear that. It is a kind of, it looks like a glamorous thing to do at the time.
At the time, yeah. You say well these guys look so sharp, and where do they get all this money?
Did you ever have to work non-musical jobs?
A few times I did, yes.

I think most musicians end up doing some of that, they may not talk about it an awful lot. When was the first — do you have a gig or a series of gigs with a certain person that you felt was really your entrance into let’s say the big time or really doing what you wanted to?
